title: Noah's Vineyard and the Curse on Canaan
description: After the flood, Noah began to farm the land and planted a vineyard. He drank some of the wine, became drunk, and lay uncovered in his tent. Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father's nakedness and told his brothers about it, while Shem and Japheth walked backward into the tent and covered their father without looking at him. When Noah woke up and learned what had happened, he cursed Canaan to be a servant of servants among his brothers, but he blessed the God of Shem and prayed that Japheth would have room and live in Shem's tents.
